email_001.subject: Project Atlas - Kickoff
email_001.body:
Hi Alice,

I wanted to reach out about the Project Atlas kickoff. We have the initial requirements document ready and I think we should schedule a meeting this week to align on timelines. The client expects the first milestone by mid-January.

Let me know your availability.

Best,
Brian

email_002.subject: Re: Project Atlas - Kickoff
email_002.body:
Hi Brian,

Thanks for sending that over. I reviewed the requirements doc and it looks solid. I'm free Thursday afternoon or Friday morning for the kickoff meeting. I've also attached my resource allocation plan for Q1 so you can see how the team bandwidth lines up.

Looking forward to getting this started.

Cheers,
Alice

email_003.subject: Re: Project Atlas - Kickoff
email_003.body:
Alice,

Thursday afternoon works perfectly. Let's do 2 PM. I'm also looping in Maya from the design team so she can share the initial wireframes during the call.

I reviewed your resource plan - looks like we might need one more backend engineer. Let's discuss.

Thanks,
Brian

email_004.subject: Re: Project Atlas - Kickoff
email_004.body:
Hi both,

Great, Thursday at 2 PM works for me. I'll have the wireframes for the dashboard and user management modules ready to present. I also have some UX research findings from a similar project that might be useful.

See you then!

Maya

email_005.subject: Budget Approval for Atlas Infrastructure
email_005.body:
Hi Alice,

Separate thread for the infrastructure budget. We need approval for the following:

- AWS hosting: $2,400/month
- CI/CD tooling: $350/month
- Monitoring and logging: $200/month

Total monthly: $2,950. Can you get sign-off from finance by end of week?

Thanks,
Brian

email_006.subject: Re: Budget Approval for Atlas Infrastructure
email_006.body:
Brian,

I spoke with finance and they approved the infrastructure budget. They just asked us to do a quarterly review to make sure usage aligns with projections. I'll set up a recurring calendar event for that.

We're all set to proceed.

Alice

email_009.subject: Dinner plans this Saturday?
email_009.body:
Hey Alice,

Are you free this Saturday for dinner? I was thinking we could try that new ramen place downtown - Tanaka Noodle House. I heard they have an amazing tonkotsu broth.

Let me know!

Kevin

That sounds great! I love ramen. Let's say 7 PM? I can make a reservation.

Alice

Perfect, 7 PM works! See you there.

Kevin

email_014.subject: Sprint Planning Notes - Dec 9
email_014.body:
Hi team,

Here are the notes from today's sprint planning session:

- Backlog groomed: 24 items prioritized
- Sprint goal: Complete user authentication module
- Blockers: Waiting on API spec from partner team
- Velocity target: 34 story points

I've attached the detailed sprint board export. Please review your assigned tickets by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Daniel

email_015.subject: Re: Sprint Planning Notes - Dec 9
email_015.body:
Daniel,

Thanks for the summary. I reviewed my tickets and everything looks reasonable. One question - should we pull in the password reset flow as well, or defer that to the next sprint?

Alice

email_017.subject: Re: Budget Approval for Atlas Infrastructure
email_017.body:
Alice,

Perfect, thanks for pushing that through quickly. I'll get the AWS accounts provisioned this week so we're ready to go after the kickoff.

One more thing - should we also budget for a staging environment? That would add roughly $800/month.

Brian

draft_001.subject: Re: Budget Approval for Atlas Infrastructure
draft_001.body:
Brian,

Good idea on the staging environment. I'll add it to the budget request. The total would then be $3,750/month. I'll prepare a cost breakdown spreadsheet for the quarterly reviews and include projected scaling costs for Q2.

draft_002.subject: End of Year Team Retrospective
draft_002.body:
Hi team,

As we wrap up 2024, I'd like to schedule an end-of-year retrospective. I'm thinking December 20th at 3 PM. We can reflect on what went well, what we can improve, and set goals for Q1 2025.

Please come prepared with your top 3 highlights and 1 area for improvement.

draft_003.subject: Birthday gift idea
draft_003.body: Hey Kevin, I was thinking about getting Maya a gift card to that art supply store she likes. What do you think? Should we split it?
